text:
Alex: quick async standup — API gateway / routing policies / auth / rate limits
Alex: done: pushed small routing fix so canary doesn't route to legacy pool, updated policy docs in conftool, rebased PR #482
Maria: done: validated canary traffic split, added a unit test for route weight math 
Sam: done: rolled the rate-limit tweak to staging, no 429s after smoothing but saw a few spikes at 95th pct
Lee: done: rotated the short-lived JWT keys in staging, verified token checks pass for internal clients
Alex: blocker: seeing a sporadic 504 when routing to model-proxy — only on seq>1024 requests, can't repro locally
Maria: q: do we want to temporarily lower max seq on gateway for safety? could do 1hr guardrail :thinking_face:
Sam: FYI I left a comment on #482 about batch size. If we drop max seq, need to adjust batching config (`BATCH_MAX_SEQ=1024 -> 512`)
Lee: blocker: key rotation uncovered a flaky auth caching bug — cache misses cause extra auth DB reads, might be contributing to latency spikes
devops-bot: deploy status: service/gateway canary 3/3 healthy, traffic 8% -> watching metrics, alerts enabled
Maria: suggestion: schedule a short post-mortem if 504s persist after retry/backoff changes — capture KB for cust-facing incidents
Sam: action: i'll add a temporary rate-smoothing rule on staging (window=30s, max_burst=2) and post results by EOD
Alex: action: will add extra logging around proxy handoffs + stack traces for seq>1024 and open a small debug build if needed
Lee: action: i'll scope an auth-cache fix, aiming for a small patch; if it's risky i'll feature-flag it behind `auth.cache_v2`
Maria: note: pinged infra to bump queue processing workers in staging to 12, should reduce tail latency for heavy bursts :pray:
Alex: thanks — if anyone wants pairing on the proxy repro i'm free 2-4pm PT, otherwise let's sync tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
